EXACT ENDPOINTS AND AUTH SPECIFICATIONS (MUST FOLLOW EXACTLY):

1. AUTH ENDPOINTS (BETTER-AUTH LIBRARY):
   - SIGN UP: POST /api/auth/sign-up/email (NOT /auth/register, NOT /users/login)
   - SIGN IN: POST /api/auth/sign-in/email (NOT /auth/login)
   - Body for sign-up: {"email": "...", "password": "...", "name": "..."}
   - Body for sign-in: {"email": "...", "password": "..."}

2. API PREFIX: ALL routes start with /api (e.g., /api/projects, /api/tasks)

3. SESSION COOKIES (NOT BEARER TOKENS):
   - Create: session = requests.Session()
   - Use session.post(), session.get() for ALL requests
   - Do NOT extract tokens from response
   - Do NOT set Authorization headers
   - Cookies are automatically handled by session object

4. PROJECT CREATION: POST /api/projects
   - Body: {"name": "...", "description": "..."}

5. TASK CREATION: POST /api/tasks
   - Body: {"projectId": "...", "title": "...", "status": "..."}

CRITICAL: The /api prefix is REQUIRED on ALL endpoints!
